description: Invert the colors of any image to create a striking photographic negative.

faqs.a: Every color channel is flipped (new value = 255 − old value), exactly like a film negative.
No — dimensions stay the same; only colors change.
faqs.q: Does it change the image size?

howto: Drop an image into the tool.
Click Download PNG to save it.
title: Image Invert Filter
